ModMetaData.name: Stay Drafted
ModMetaData.author: w0bderful
ModMetaData.description:
Use the normal Draft command to keep player-controlled pawns drafted. No extra button is required. Manual undrafting and forced undrafting still work; only idle automatic undrafting is blocked.
An optional Allow auto-undraft button uses a cancel icon and is hidden by default. When shown, it defaults to off for each pawn. Enabling it delegates that pawn's idle undrafting to vanilla without immediately changing their drafted state.
A persistent alert warns when a spawned humanlike player pawn has remained continuously drafted for 24 in-game hours. The threshold is configurable from 1 to 168 hours. Undrafting immediately clears the timer and alert; redrafting starts a new period. Timers and per-pawn opt-outs survive save/load.
The event-driven monitor checks only tracked drafted pawns every 600 ticks. Alerts may appear up to 14.4 in-game minutes after the threshold. Colony mechs are excluded from this warning. Settings: Options > Mod settings > Stay Drafted. Requires Harmony.
